page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8a.48xlarge is a compute-optimized instance powered by the x86_64 architecture. It features 192 dedicated vCPUs utilizing AMD EPYC 9T24 processors running at a base clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The instance is equipped with 384.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. This configuration operates on the KVM hypervisor, ensuring dedicated CPU allocation for workloads requiring consistent compute performance.

The instance does not include bundled local storage or integrated GPUs, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. For network connectivity, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 64 Gbps, facilitating high-throughput data transfers. Given its high core count and compute-to-memory ratio of 1:2, the ecs.c8a.48xlarge is designed for compute-intensive workloads such as high-performance computing (HPC), large-scale batch processing, video encoding, and distributed analytics.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8a.48xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the x86_64 architecture and running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 192 dedicated vCPUs from AMD EPYC 9T24 processors clocked at 2.7 GHz, paired with 384.0 GB of system memory, yielding a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio. The instance does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, relying entirely on network-attached storage options. It delivers a baseline network bandwidth of 64 Gbps to support high-throughput data transfers. This server is engineered for compute-heavy workloads, including high-performance computing, large-scale batch processing, video encoding, and distributed simulation tasks that require massive parallel processing capabilities without requiring high memory-to-core ratios.
